import numpy as np

def avg_pose(name, n=10):
    ps = [get_object_pose(name)[0] for _ in range(n)]
    return np.mean(ps, axis=0)

# Perceive nut center, block, and handle grasp (average to reduce noise)
nut_center = avg_pose("white hollow center of the brown square nut")
block_pos = avg_pose("brown square block")

grasp_pos, grasp_quat = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")
grasp_positions = [grasp_pos]
for _ in range(9):
    p, _ = sample_grasp_pose("extruded handle of the brown square nut")
    grasp_positions.append(p)
grasp_pos = np.mean(grasp_positions, axis=0)

# Rigid offset from gripper (handle) to nut center in world frame (orientation held fixed during transport)
offset = nut_center - grasp_pos

# Grasp the handle
goto_home_joint_position()
open_gripper()
goto_pose(grasp_pos, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.10)
close_gripper()

# Lift
lift_pos = grasp_pos + np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.20])
goto_pose(lift_pos, grasp_quat)

# Target nut center directly above block, then compute gripper target by removing the offset
hover_height = 0.12
target_center_high = np.array([block_pos[0], block_pos[1], block_pos[2] + hover_height])
target_center_low = np.array([block_pos[0], block_pos[1], block_pos[2] + 0.01])

gripper_high = target_center_high - offset
gripper_low = target_center_low - offset

goto_pose(gripper_high, grasp_quat)
goto_pose(gripper_low, grasp_quat, z_approach=0.05)

# Release nut onto the peg
open_gripper()
goto_pose(gripper_high, grasp_quat)
goto_home_joint_position()
